boundaries.http: Node performance.now: before fetch through complete response arrayBuffer; includes HTTP/server validation/hash/SQL commit/serialization; excludes request preparation and client JSON.parse
boundaries.snapshotInstall: Chromium performance.now around actual LocalStore.applySnapshot: validation+known-row scan+atomic IndexedDB puts; no network/DOM
boundaries.validation: Chromium performance.now around actual validateSnapshot only
boundaries.queue: Chromium performance.now around actual LocalStore.pending only
boundaries.foreground: Chromium performance.now around PushController.reviewLatest or synchronize through final local commit; includes Vite proxy/HTTP and IndexedDB, excludes fixture/save/freeze/first unknown commit preparation
boundaries.growth: Actual pg_total_relation_size/table/index bytes; includes heap/TOAST/index allocation and dead tuples, no VACUUM or future extrapolation

environmentNotes: Warm steady-state samples; server/browser startup and seed setup excluded
No cold-start performance, mobile/WAN, production load or causal architecture comparison
All processes colocated, caches warm, default durability, background OS workloads uncontrolled
IndexedDB install reuses already-known clean records after warmup; validation primed immediately before combined install
Same-record race clock/throughput boundaries differ from isolated request timings; do not compare as equal workloads
One precommitted unknown per foreground cycle; fixture commit intentionally outside timed interval; original same-ID replay inside
